notes.title: 🎉Happy New Year🎉
notes.notes:
The new year brings a special treat for all party game lovers! Xentripetal Force is now completely FREE to play on Steam! 🥳

Get ready for fast-paced ping-pong-style action game with up to 4 players in this exciting local multiplayer party game. Whether you're serving, smashing, or pulling off impossible saves, it’s all about quick reflexes, strategic plays, and having a blast with friends.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1131690/Xentripetal_Force/][h1]Download it now and let the party begin![/h1][/url]
